observations: Photo 0: Interior of an open chest freezer, metal liner with frost/ice buildup and some dark staining on walls.

Photo 1: Front view of a white chest freezer with lid open; a circular sticker reads 'Haier Thermocool', '2 Years Warranty', and 'Chain Compressor'; visible rust spots along the bottom edge of the cabinet.
Photo 2: Rear view showing condenser coil, a rating label (text not legible), a power plug, and rust at the lower corners of the casing.

claims.evidence: No power-on or running clip provided; brand is visible in photo 1 but reliability cannot be judged from stills.

claims.claim: Strong capacity, long-lasting freezing for up to five (days, implied)
claims.evidence: No thermometer reading, no video showing sustained cold retention; frost in photo 0 could be pre-existing or manually placed.
Sticker in photo 1 shows a warranty badge, but this reflects the original manufacturer warranty period, not current coverage status; no proof of purchase date or active warranty.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or cool effectively (compressor failure, gas leak).
risks.proof: A video clip of the unit plugged in, running, with audible compressor hum and visible frost forming over a few minutes, or a thermometer reading showing sub-zero interior temperature.

risks.risk: Visible rust at the base (photos 1 and 2) may indicate corrosion of the cabinet or leakage history, lowering resale value and raising failure risk.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rusted areas and the base/feet to assess severity and whether it has penetrated the insulation or coolant lines.
risks.if_unproven: priced as significant cosmetic/structural damage, deducted from a working-unit price

risks.risk: Interior frost shown in photo 0 may not reflect a true cooling test; could be residual ice from freezer being unplugged or staged.
risks.proof: A video showing the freezer being plugged in from a warm/empty state and frost developing naturally over time.

risks.risk: No model number visible, so exact capacity and age/generation of the unit cannot be confirmed, affecting comparable pricing.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rating label on the back (visible but unreadable in photo 2) showing model number, capacity, and manufacture date.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic small/mid-capacity Haier Thermocool chest freezer at worst case

proof_requests: Video of the freezer plugged in and running, showing compressor sound and door seal, ideally with a thermometer inside.
Clear, well-lit photo of the rating label on the rear (photo 2) showing model number and capacity.
Close-up photos of the rusted areas at the base front and rear to assess corrosion severity.
Photo of the door gasket/seal condition for air-tightness.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by brand and type as a used Haier Thermocool chest freezer, but working condition is unverified and visible rust is a real defect, so it must be priced at worst case (not confirmed working, with cosmetic/structural rust) until the seller provides a running test and clearer label/rust photos.
